title: Empty States
summary: Empty states distinguish first use, filtered no-results, no records, no permission and unavailable data; this doc owns general empty-state copy, while dashboard-specific empty states live in SAAS-008.

MUST.text: Explain the actual reason and offer the action that resolves it.
Distinguish "no data yet", "no matches" and "unavailable" in copy.

SHOULD.text: Use demo data only when clearly labeled and isolated.
Keep empty-state copy under ~2 lines plus one primary action.

AVOID.text: Do not show fake zeros or imply records exist.
Do not reuse the same copy for every empty cause.

DECIDE.decision: Explain value and provide a create action
Show active filters and a clear-filters action
Explain access and the request path
State cause and offer retry or support

EXAMPLE.good: "No invoices match these filters" with "Clear filters"
EXAMPLE.bad: Blank list with no reason or action

FAILURE_MODES: Blank screens read as broken or loading.
Fake zeros mislead decisions and reporting.
Generic copy hides the fix the user needs.
Demo data mixed with production corrupts metrics.
